hypotheses.hypothesis: A provisional shape checkpoint could be recorded as passed era likeness while finish discrepancies remain open.
hypotheses.observed_outcome: MB-T012 uses 'Pass' and maps V09/V10, but its listed prerequisites omit MB-T021-027. Its closure text prohibits full track completion. The later MB-T020 owner-decision path reaches most finish work through MB-T019/026; explicit exact-candidate owner decisions remain required. Thus the local semantic ambiguity survives, while a documentary bypass of final owner acceptance is not established.
hypotheses.smallest_decisive_test: Root evaluates a harmless mock closure with MB-T012 shape/evidence prerequisites complete, MB-T022-027 OPEN, and owner decisions PENDING. If this can produce V09/V10 accepted or 'static likeness passed', objection survives. If only a provisional comparison can close, retaining those criteria open, objection is defeated.
hypotheses.minimal_remedy: Rename MB-T012 as a provisional whole-character comparison checkpoint and require an explicit open finish/era discrepancy register, or add applicable finish prerequisites before claiming passed static likeness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A coherent July-style head could improve a crop yet preserve the defining snout/body mismatch or import July's excluded body and hanging wings.
hypotheses.observed_outcome: The roadmap explicitly requires hooked bill/root, cheek negative space, swept crown, recessed optic, whole-head landmarks, cervical join, breast/shoulder and compact mantle checks. MB-T013 retains source scopes; MB-T014 requires all-era eight-view evidence; MB-T012 reviews the complete bird. Missing whole-body coverage is therefore not supported by the document. The actual successor may still fail these gates; no successor exists in this review to falsify that possibility.
hypotheses.smallest_decisive_test: Compare successor and retained baseline in unlabeled matched neutral full profiles and three-quarter views against the locked full-bird source, then head crops against July only. One persisting drooping snout, hidden neck, incorrect head/body mass or expanded hanging wing defeats a crop-only gain; source-supported landmark relationships across both views defeat this counterexample within tested scope.
hypotheses.test_execution_status: not-run; no successor or fresh image judgment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Shared head geometry could be treated as era completion despite weak Maker/Mechanic finish distinction or an Advanced optic copied into early eras.
hypotheses.observed_outcome: Recorded actual-image findings retain weak finish distinction. MB-T005 prohibits early awakening; MB-T025 requires three-era native/browser head pairs in both lights; MB-T022-024 separate era finishes and MB-T020 requires exact per-era decisions. No documented closure licenses a common patina or common glowing optic. Hash equality and the supplied limited image set do not establish era material twins.
hypotheses.smallest_decisive_test: At the first successor packet, inspect aligned Maker/Mechanic/Advanced full-bird and head/breast pairs against each pinned era finish reference in both lights. An early glowing optic or persistent indistinguishable regional finish keeps affected V09/era cells open. Distinct source-supported finishes and eligible optics defeat this counterexample in those tested regions.
